newsitem.title: USA: Intl Specialty Products names Heinze president.
newsitem.headline: Intl Specialty Products names Heinze president.

text.p: International Specialty Products Inc said on Monday it had named Peter Heinze as president and chief operating officer.

Heinze will succeed Carl Eckardt, who will remain a member of the board and assume his former position as executive vice president-corporate development. Eckardt was also elected vice chairman of International Specialty's parent company, GAF Corp.
Heinze most recently served as senior vice president-chemicals and a member of the operating committee at PPG Industries Inc.
